text:
maria: Opening thread — we need a coordinated quota/peering escalation across GCP and AWS for the APAC onboarding spike.
aj: tl;dr what exact quotas do we need and where?
sanjay: GCP ap-southeast1: request increase for GPUs (2 -> 12 L4A), and increase regional static external IP quota by +20 for nat gateways.
lisa: AWS ap-southeast-2: need additional ENI and accelerator quota for p4de.16xlarge — target +4 instances, plus EC2 On-Demand vCPU soft limit bump.
maria: I already opened GCP case 123456789012345 — they acknowledged, but asked for billing account consent and a business justification doc.
ivan: I attached the justification (short): high-throughput inference pilot for customer X, expected 2M tokens/day, SLA 99.9%. Please escalate.
aj: @maria can you paste the exact gcloud snippet they requested? saves back-and-forth.
maria: They wanted the project id, billing account id, and a sample provisioning plan. I posted this to the case:
```text
Project: redwood-prod-apac
Billing: 01A2B3-CUST-000
Requested quota change: compute.googleapis.com/GPUs (nvidia-l4a): 2 -> 12
compute.googleapis.com/addresses (regional static): +20
Justification: inference fleet expansion for pilot customer, expect traffic growth curve and critical latency requirements. Temp 90-day increase.
```
cloud-bot: deploy-check: staging cluster in ap-southeast1 currently reports 2/12 GPUs available; autoscaler capped by quota.
maria: GCP responded: "Case 123456789012345: We need organization admin approval for quota changes. If you can't provide, we can route to our APAC escalation team — reply 'escalate' to proceed." 
aj: escalate — do it now. We'll provide org admin approval in parallel.
sanjay: I DM'd infra-ops account to approve. @ivan please confirm once they click approve.
ivan: infra-ops approved in Org console at 1848001305, I attached the screenshot to the GCP case.
maria: GCP support updated case — moving to APAC escalation group, ETA 8 business hours. Case status: Escalated. Note the contact: gcp-support@google.com and escalation ref GCP-ESCL-APAC-7721.
lisa: On the AWS side I opened case 9876543210 — support asked for a capacity plan and list of instance IDs to be provisioned.
aj: paste AWS request here so we can copy/paste.
lisa: AWS text I used:
```text
Account: 987654321098
Region: ap-southeast-2
Quota: EC2 Accelerator (p4de): increase from 0 -> 4 instances
ENI limit: increase by +50
Business justification: low-latency inference for customer X, production pilot, will reserve capacity. Temporary increase for 60 days.
```
aws-support: (bot) Case 9876543210 acknowledged — assigned to TAM Lucy H. Requesting confirmation of payment method and expected start date. Response ETA: 24 hours.
maria: Also hit a VPC peering snag — GCP says peer-to-peer route limits in our infra org are near saturation in apac projects. We need a quota add for custom routes per VPN/peering connection.
ivan: Ticket created: GCP case 123456789012346 for routes. Requested increase from 250 -> 800 per VPC for peering usage.
sanjay: Quick note on costs: estimate for 12 L4A + 4 p4de sustained for a week = roughly $65k. Finance ok with pilot but wants a hard stop date and cost cap alerting.
aj: Set alerting in billing: create budget $80k with 60% and 90% alerts to finance@redwood.com and ops@redwood.com.
ivan: Done — budget created and alerts wired.
maria: For transparency, attaching the minimal runbook for on-call if quota provisioning fails:
```text
1) If GCP doesn't grant within 24h — request temporary placement group in eu-west, fallback routing to eu-gcp cluster.
2) If AWS capacity delayed — request Reserved Capacity burst via Partner (contact: cloud-partner@redwood.com).
3) Notify product + customer success and set feature flag to degrade to cached responses.
```
lisa: FYI TAM Lucy asked for expected start date — I replied "2026-06-01" and provided our provisioning playbook link.
aj: Please keep messages short in the case notes — support triage hates walls of text.
maria: GCP case updated again: Escalation confirm — next update by 1848003000 UTC. They asked to confirm whether we can accept cross-project DB peering — we said yes.
sanjay: Also scheduled a 30-min sync tomorrow 09:00 APAC with GCP/AWS reps and finance to confirm everything.
ivan: calendar invite sent to eng-infra, finance, product, customer-success.
cloud-bot: reminder: quota-monitoring job will poll cases every 2h and pings this thread on status changes.
aj: thanks everyone. I'll own the follow-up if anything is delayed. :thumbsup:
maria: closing the thread once both cases are in "Provisioned" state. please post case updates here.
gcp-support: (bot) Case 123456789012345 status: Escalated -> In Progress. ETA 6 business hours. Reference: GCP-ESCL-APAC-7721.
aws-support: (bot) Case 9876543210 status: Pending TAM action. Expected contact within 24h.
